settings.repere: Paragraphe · These photos are taken 3 weeks apart. I
settings.text: These photos are taken 3 weeks apart. I used to have clear skin and after stopping birth control, I experienced new adult acne. I tried everything, benzoyl peroxide, salicylic acid, Blume acne products (which eventually stopped working). I even went to a dermatologist who only suggested going on birth control again or taking medication. I was at a breaking point and decided to give Norse Organics a shot. I was worried that the reviews would be gimmicky and fake but I figured it was worth a shot for clean ingredients. After the first week, my skin did get worse and I almost stopped. The team at Norse Organics helped me through every step. I stuck with it and slowly but surely, my coloration improved, the texture evened, and my amount of pimples lessened. If pimples did pop up, they were not longer cysts but small white heads that healed within a day. Unfortunately, I had an allergic reaction to the almond in the product. Norse refunded me 100% without any questions asked. I am so sad to have to stop the product. Since getting off of Norse, my acne is now coming back. For those who do not have a nut allergy, I don’t just HIGHLY recommend but URGE you to try it🤍 Norse, please make a nut free version!! My skin needs to get back onto your products, it was the boost my confidence needed in the short month that I used it

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The products work, just with consistent
settings.text: The products work, just with consistent use and lack of using makeup. Definitely takes some time to see results. As a student I was surprised by the sizes when it arrived given the prices, buts it’s lasted quite a while as you only need a little. Not a huge fan of the orange look you get from the morning one but it works at preventing breakouts when I normally get them from touching my face during the day. Scarring is slowly fading from the night cream although it’s not a super hydrating cream, more of a serum feel. The exfoliating one is extremely harsh but good for removing crusty skin post breakout, I don’t use very often as it’s harsh like sandpaper. Gone through lots of acne products and I’d say it works - but there are other products out there that could do a similar job for a fraction of the price, but you wouldn’t get the organic ingredients or that nice natural herbal scent you get from Norse. Would recommend if you can afford.

settings.text: Only been 3 weeks, heres some backstory I'm in my late teens and struggle with cystic, hormonal, and closed comedone acne.
